statements.text: H. Res. 286. A resolution of inquiry requesting the President to transmit certain documents relating to the dangerous, unaccountable use of AI by the United States DOGE Service to jeopardize the private information and essential services of the American people; to the Committee on Oversight and Government Reform.
statements.context: Introduction of public bills and resolutions in the House of Representatives, including H. Res. 286 by Representative Stansbury.

statements.text: And yesterday, I heard Marjorie Taylor Greene, I was standing on the Floor while she gave a speech on this very language that is in this bill that would literally say that states and localities cannot enforce their own data rules or AI. It preempts federalism. It preempts state law. It would prevent states from protecting their own citizens.
statements.context: House committee hearing on 'The Federal Government in the Age of Artificial Intelligence,' discussing preemption language in a pending bill.

statements.text: So, you mentioned that part of why this deregulation language is in here that would preempt state and local laws regarding the regulation of AI systems is, in part, be- cause of this $500 million request that is in the bill.
